location.description: Location where the OAuth client is deployed. Must always be global.
location.rationale: Ensures OAuth configuration consistency across GCP IAM services.

oauth_client_id.description: Unique OAuth client ID. Must be 6–63 characters, lowercase letters, digits, or hyphens. Cannot start or end with hyphen and cannot use 'gcp-' prefix.
oauth_client_id.rationale: Prevents insecure or invalid OAuth client identifiers.

client_type.description: Type of OAuth client. Only PUBLIC_CLIENT or CONFIDENTIAL_CLIENT are allowed.
client_type.rationale: Restricts OAuth client types to approved security models.

allowed_scopes.description: List of OAuth scopes allowed for authentication flows.
allowed_scopes.rationale: Restricting scopes reduces access exposure and privilege escalation risk.

allowed_grant_types.description: OAuth grant types allowed for the client.

allowed_redirect_uris.description: List of allowed redirect URIs after authentication.
allowed_redirect_uris.rationale: Prevents redirect attacks and phishing risks.

disabled.description: Indicates whether the OAuth client is disabled.
disabled.rationale: Disabled clients cannot be used for authentication.

display_name.description: Human-readable name for the OAuth client.

description.description: Optional description of the OAuth client.

project.description: GCP project where the OAuth client is created.
